About HX Auto Service

A Pusat Servis Kereta in Taman Bukit Indah: maintenance, repair and recovery towing from one workshop.

From the signboard

HX AUTO SERVICE

PUSAT SERVIS KERETA

DIMILIKI OLEH: HX AUTO SERVICE (003403340-D)

The workshop

You will know us by the black signboard: HX AUTO SERVICE, PUSAT SERVIS KERETA, with the red shield. Inside are the lifts and bays where we service and repair cars from Johor Bahru and across the Second Link.

What we do

Maintenance, repair and recovery towing. Computer diagnostics and coding, oil change and general service, engine and transmission, aircond, brakes, suspension, tyres and alignment, battery and electrical, and undercarriage checks.

Cars we see

Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Toyota Alphard and Vellfire, Honda, Kia, Mazda, Mini, Subaru, Nissan, Lexus, Land Rover and Volkswagen have all been through the bay.
